manifest_row.title: Manitobans can't afford the Liberal carbon tax

screening.main_topic: An opinion piece opposing Canada’s Liberal carbon tax, arguing that it raises costs without reducing emissions and advocating an alternative environmental plan.
screening.climate_relevance: The article directly debates carbon pricing as climate policy, its expected effect on greenhouse-gas emissions, and its fairness and economic consequences. It also includes a brief statement supporting climate action and citing Canadian warming.
screening.reason: Although the argument emphasizes household and business costs, the carbon tax’s role as an environmental measure and its effectiveness in addressing emissions are central to the piece. The text also includes a separate 'Both sides now' climate-related excerpt.
